the inclusion of a blended animal-marines protein product in dairy diets resulted in a significant increase in milk yield of 1.24 ± 0.05 (SEM) kg/d of milk.
inclusion of a 2 to 4% animal- marine protein blend in the diet of 35 dairy herd increased milk yield 1.24 (SEM = 1.24) kg/d of milk.
the inclusion of a 2 to 4% blended protein product (animal-marine) in the diets of lactating dairy cows increased milk yield in most herds.

a blended animal-marin protein product.
the effect of a blended animal and marine protein supplement on milk yield and milk components.

the use of the animal-marina protein blend in the diets of 22 herds resulted in an average increase in milk production of 1.24 +/- 0.05 (SEM) kg/d of milk.
the inclusion of the protein blend in the diets of the dairy cows studied in this experiment resulted in an increase in daily milk production of 1.24 +/- 0.05 (SEM) kg of milk.
the animal-marine product had a positive effect on production in the majority of herds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the animal-marine blended product increased milk production in 19 herds (54%) and decreased milk production in 4 herds (12%).
the animal-marine blend protein product had a positive influence on milk yield, and the effect was greatest in early lactation.
the animal-marine product was beneficial to the 19 herds that showed a significant increase in milk production.
The main takeaway from our work is that
inclusion of a protein blend at 2 to 4% of diet DM can be used to increase milk yield in a wide range of herds, and that the response to the protein is greatest in midlactation cows.
